definitions.explanation: An award given for achievement in literature. Japan has many prestigious literary awards that receive significant media attention.

examples.japanese: {文学賞|ぶんがくしょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受賞|じゅしょう}→受賞：11867_jushou⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{作品|さくひん}→作品：02776_sakuhin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{文学賞|ぶんがくしょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{候補|こうほ}→候補：02804_kouho⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{選|えら}ばれた→選ぶ：00835_erabu⟧。
examples.english: This work was nominated for a literary award.

examples.japanese: ⟦{芥川賞|あくたがわしょう}→芥川賞：15559_akutagawashou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{最|もっと}も→最も：01736_mottomo⟧⟦{有名|ゆうめい}→有名：01106_yuumei⟧な{文学賞|ぶんがくしょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{一|ひと}つ→一つ：02948_hitotsu⟧だ。
examples.english: The Akutagawa Prize is one of the most famous literary awards in Japan.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{文学|ぶんがく}→文学：01505_bungaku⟧ (literature) + ⟦{賞|しょう}→賞：03227_shou⟧ (prize, award). Literary prizes are major cultural events in Japan and receive wide media coverage, especially the biannual announcement of the ⟦{芥川賞|あくたがわしょう}→芥川賞：15559_akutagawashou⟧ and ⟦{直木賞|なおきしょう}→直木賞：15560_naokishou⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {文学賞|ぶんがくしょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受賞|じゅしょう}→受賞：11867_jushou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to win a literary prize
- {文学賞|ぶんがくしょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{候補|こうほ}→候補：02804_kouho⟧: literary prize nominee
- {文学賞|ぶんがくしょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{選考|せんこう}→選考：03774_senkou⟧: literary prize selection process
- {文学賞|ぶんがくしょう}⟦{受賞作|じゅしょうさく}→受賞作：24141_jushousaku⟧: literary prize-winning work

CULTURAL NOTE:
Major Japanese literary prizes include:
- ⟦{芥川賞|あくたがわしょう}→芥川賞：15559_akutagawashou⟧: Akutagawa Prize — for promising new writers of literary fiction
- ⟦{直木賞|なおきしょう}→直木賞：15560_naokishou⟧: Naoki Prize — for established writers of popular fiction
- {本屋大賞|ほんやたいしょう}: Bookstore Grand Prize — chosen by bookstore staff
